main_body: A hospital bed drawn lengthwise: a barred headboard at the top (rows 11-20), then a long white mattress with a pillow and a blue blanket stripe (rows 22-42), and a short footboard at the bottom (rows 43-46).
top_band: White mattress, rows 22-42 (about 21 rows, L 201-255) directly under the headboard. It is the whole body, not a foreshortened top. A headboard sits above it (rows 11-20, L 39-170).
evidence: The mattress, pillow and blanket are seen from straight above and fill about 21 of 37 rows. The only south face is a 4-row footboard (rows 43-46) that fades smoothly from L170 to L61, with no distinct front-edge line or eave shadow. The headboard is a flat front-facing panel with bars, drawn in elevation. This matches the guide's red top-down slab with almost no front face, so the bed reads as a plank seen from above rather than a 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The candidate has 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 13 colours per tile against 17 and 20. Its dark edge pixels are 99% neutral (#22282e), a grey-black sticker outline, whereas the references use tinted outlines (1% and 33% neutral). Its grey-white ramp has about 5 steps and little grain, so the surfaces are smooth and plain beside the reference stall and well. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, but the palette is far thinner and the outline is near_black, so it would look flatter and more sticker-like next to the references.
